source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.4 says it optimized XLA-generated IR for FlashAttention and surrounding input/output processing; each modification was checked against unmodified reference code on randomized inputs, and the final version was confirmed by human experts for all possible inputs.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can validate a compiler domain gate, a final reference-correctness gate, and compiler_ir_provenance metadata for IR origin, editability, baseline provenance, reference hashes, randomized input-generator hashes, tolerance policy, final-expert scope, per-edit reference check metadata, and artifact refs. It does not claim real reference implementation artifacts, randomized input-generator artifacts, candidate edit sequence artifacts, per-edit reference check outputs, randomized input seed or coverage records, tolerance/failure-policy artifacts, kernel/pre/postprocessing attribution artifacts, edit artifact refs, final expert all-input confirmation files, or expert/owner signoff files.
